data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'stephanos' meaning crown or wreath. In the New Testament, the name Stephanus appears as a name of several early Christian martyrs. In the Acts of the Apostles, Stephanus is the name of a deacon in the early Christian church in Jerusalem. The name Stephanus carries the meaning “Crown, wreath” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Stephanus usually hope their child will grow to embody crown, wreath and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name Stephanus continues to be popular among Christians today, as a reminder of the early martyrs who gave their lives for their faith.
